$comment: The machine-readable contract. Every variant in semantic.json must define exactly these roles. docs/ROLES.md is generated from this file.

roles.bg.base: Main canvas: editor and terminal background
roles.bg.sunken: Chrome that sits below the canvas: sidebar, activity bar, title bar, inactive tabs
roles.bg.raised: Slightly lifted areas: line highlight, hovered rows, panel headers
roles.bg.overlay: Floating UI: menus, dropdowns, suggestion lists, notifications

roles.fg.subtle: Tertiary text: line numbers, placeholders, inactive tabs

roles.accent.primary: The brand color: focus, links, primary buttons, status bar
roles.accent.primary.hover: Lighter companion of the primary accent, for hover states
roles.accent.secondary: The highlight color: cursor, active markers, badges

roles.status.error: Errors, deletions, failures. Nothing else uses this hue

roles.syntax.keyword: Keywords, storage modifiers, control flow, this/self
roles.syntax.constant: Named constants, booleans, null, enum members
roles.syntax.property: Object properties and keys: JSON, YAML, CSS properties
roles.syntax.tag: Markup, HTML and JSX tag names

roles.markup.heading: Markdown headings (bold)
roles.markup.code: Inline code and fenced code blocks

roles.ansi.black: ANSI black, lifted just enough to stay visible on bg.base
roles.ansi.brightBlack: ANSI bright black, used for dimmed text
